name: cl-cross-border
description: Chile cross-border income tax for tax year 2026 (año comercial 2026, año tributario 2027): the Impuesto Adicional (IA) on Chilean-source income of non-residents under LIR arts. 58 to 60 and the withholding by the Chilean payer (art. 74 No. 4), paid in Form F50 by the 12th of the next month (art. 79). Covers permanent establishments (art. 58 No. 1), indirect transfers of Chilean assets (art. 58 No. 3), services (35%, technical and engineering 15%, 20% to preferential regimes), insurance 22%, reinsurance 2%, sea freight 5%, ship charters 20%, art. 60 income at 35% and 20% for scientific, cultural and sports work, the exemptions of art. 59 No. 2 and 59 bis, thin capitalisation under art. 41 F (3 times equity, 35% sole tax), treaty relief with the residence certificate, the foreign tax credit of residents (art. 41 A, 35% caps) and the annual DJ 1929 on operations abroad. Trigger on: impuesto adicional, retención artículo 74 N°4, formulario 50, F50, servicios del exterior, exceso de endeuda
